attempts.visual_review: Initial generation repeats polished contemporary fighting-manga rendering; requested gothic atmosphere and fine line distinction are not evident.
Revision adds darker tone but invents ornamental costume detail and separate weapon studies; style still reads as contemporary manga.
Revision removes some extra rendering noise but retains separate weapon diagrams, added gold costume details, saturated blue, and the same modern manga rendering.
Final revision removes separate object studies, but visual language and costume remain nearly identical to adjacent modern manga sheets; gothic Ayami distinction was not achieved.

blocker: Four preserved generations (initial plus three directed revisions) retain substantially the same polished contemporary fighting-manga rendering and saturated blue ornamental costume as adjacent styles; they do not achieve the delicate gothic Ayami-inspired line, slender refined proportions, or muted wine/midnight palette. The final attempt also retains an unapproved coat-like silhouette. No candidate sheet is registered.
next_action: Revisit after progressing through independent styles; consider a distinct art direction or generation method with owner input. Do not promote any attempt as the style-specific sheet.
